exposure: embryo transfers with preimplantation genetic testing (PGT)
cohort: The study included data from 18,127 fresh or frozen transfers performed in 25 Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) centers across Turkey in 2019.
finding: The survey found varying live birth rates per embryo transfer (30.6% for fresh, 40.1% for frozen, and 50.7% for PGT cycles) and reported that 65.3% of all transfers involved a single embryo, leading to 86.1% singleton live births.
